Facility Tour Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement
This FACILITY TOUR CONFIDENTIALITY AND NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of this date: ____________ between Hydranautics, a California corporation (“Hydranautics”) and __________________ (“Visitor”).
During the facility tour(s), Visitor will observe Hydranautics’ business operations and facilities which may give Visitor access to some of Hydranautics’ Confidential Information as defined below.
Accordingly, as a condition of and in consideration of touring Hydranautics’ facilities, Visitor agrees that:
1. The term “Confidential Information” shall include all Hydranautics’ trade secrets and information that concerns the confidential business or affairs of Hydranautics and Nitto including without limitation, financial information and reports, business plans, design and construction plans, manufacturing processes, customer lists, employee data, forecasts, strategies, and all other proprietary business information.
2. Visitor agrees and acknowledges that in the course of, or incident to, the tour of Hydranautics’ facilities, Hydranutics may provide to, or Visitor will otherwise become exposed to Hydranautics’ Confidential Information.
3. Visitor agrees to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and will exercise at least the same care with respect thereto as it exercises with respect to its’ own confidential or proprietary information and will not without Hydranautics’ consent use, divulge, copy, release, sell, loan or otherwise reveal such Confidential Information to others.
4. Visitor agrees he/she will not remove any document, equipment or other materials from the premises without Hydranautics’ written consent. Visitor will not photograph, videotape, or otherwise make any record of or preserve any Confidential Information to which he/she may be given access during the facility tour(s).
5. Visitor will abide by all safety regulations, stay within designated areas of the facility per the established tour, and will not leave the touring party without an escort by a Hydranautics authorized employee.
6. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
7. This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter.
8. Visitor understands that his or her breach of this Agreement may subject him or her and his or her employees to liability.

检查完整当前来源，找出所有实际生效的内部人员或专业服务接收者披露规范窗口。定义、序言、人员信息描述和仅需另行授权的例外不是候选。只有检查全部当前单元后才可选择 none_in_complete_source。原始 TRAIN 正例（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.” 原始 TRAIN 正例（逐字）：“3. Neither party shall disclose the Confidential Information received from the other to any person or entity, except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents (collectively “Representatives”) involved in the performance of the Project, or to use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than fulfilling its obligations under the Project.”

窗口把人员类别置于保密义务范围，但没有足够许可措辞。
窗口不是实际披露规范。

判断整个供应窗口的披露规范效力，不把定义、序言或省略文字补成许可。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”
窗口明确覆盖接收方自己的员工或工作人员。
完整供应窗口没有明确覆盖接收方自己的员工或工作人员。

判断供应披露窗口是否明确覆盖接收方自己的员工或工作人员；不得把受控实体员工、承包商或顾问改写为接收方员工。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”
窗口明确覆盖受控、控制或共同控制实体的员工。
完整供应窗口没有明确覆盖此类实体员工。

判断供应披露窗口是否明确覆盖由接收方控制、被其控制或与其共同控制实体的员工，不得将其扁平化为接收方自身员工。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“2.1.3 only to disclose the Confidential Information to employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient, consultants and/or advisors to whom disclosure is necessary for the Permitted Purpose and then only on the understanding that such employees, consultants and/or advisors are expressly subject to the provisions of this Confidentiality Agreement.”
窗口明确覆盖承包商或独立承包商。
完整供应窗口没有明确覆盖承包商。

判断供应披露窗口是否明确覆盖承包商或独立承包商，不得由员工、顾问或代理人推断。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”
窗口明确覆盖顾问 consultants。
完整供应窗口没有明确覆盖 consultants。

判断供应披露窗口是否明确覆盖 consultants；不得由 contractors、agents 或 advisers 推断。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Auditor shall restrict disclosure of such Confidential Information to its employees and/or consultants with a need to know (and advise such employees and/or consultants of the obligations assumed herein), shall use the Confidential Information only for the purposes set forth in the Agreement, and shall not disclose such Confidential Information to any affiliates, subsidiaries, associates and/or third party without prior written approval of the Auditee.”
窗口明确覆盖代理人 agents。
完整供应窗口没有明确覆盖 agents。

判断供应披露窗口是否明确覆盖 agents，不得由 representatives 或其他专业人员自动推断。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”
窗口明确覆盖至少一种专业顾问角色。
完整供应窗口没有明确覆盖专业顾问角色。

判断供应披露窗口是否明确覆盖 professional advisers、legal advisers、financial advisers 或同类明确专业顾问；不得由一般 consultant 或 agent 推断。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”

完整供应窗口没有陈述 need-to-know 条件。

判断供应披露窗口是否明示接收者必须具有 need-to-know，不得从必要目的或保密义务推断。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”
窗口明示必要程度限制。
完整供应窗口没有陈述必要程度限制。

判断供应披露窗口是否把披露或知识范围限制在所述目的所必需的程度。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”
窗口要求书面保密协议或书面约束。
窗口要求保密约束，但没有要求另行书面协议。
完整供应窗口没有陈述接收者保密保障。

判断供应披露窗口对接收者规定的保密保障，并区分另行书面约束与非书面保密义务。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”

检查全部当前来源单元后，没有发现实际返还或销毁义务。

检查完整当前来源，找出所有实际返还或销毁义务窗口；证据须覆盖动作、材料、触发及紧邻资格。只有检查全部当前单元后才可选择 none_in_complete_source。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“5.2 If the disclosing Party so requests in writing, the receiving Party shall immediately:- 5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and 5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them.”
窗口只要求销毁或永久擦除。
同一义务允许返还或销毁二选一。
返还是通常动作，销毁仅在来源所述授权下替代。
返还与销毁均被要求，并可适用于不同材料范围。
窗口有其他明确动作连接，须由逐字证据限定。
窗口没有实际返还或销毁动作。

判断供应窗口的动作连接，区分二选一、有条件授权替代以及不同材料范围上的返还并销毁。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“2.1.7 upon demand of the OSCE, to promptly return all Confidential Information (in whatever medium), together with all copies thereof or, where expressly authorised in writing by the OSCE, to destroy or delete all such Confidential Information and shall confirm to the OSCE in writing that such destruction or deletion has taken place.” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and 5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them.”

只判断返还动作的实际触发，不把销毁动作的触发复制给返还。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Each party agrees that all Confidential Information of the other party, including any copies thereof, shall be returned to the disclosing party upon request or destroyed within ten (10) business days of the expiration or other termination of the Project.”
销毁由请求或要求触发。
销毁由协议终止或到期触发。

销毁有其他逐字明示触发。
窗口没有销毁动作或没有陈述销毁触发。

只判断销毁或永久擦除动作的实际触发，不把返还动作的触发复制给销毁。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Each party agrees that all Confidential Information of the other party, including any copies thereof, shall be returned to the disclosing party upon request or destroyed within ten (10) business days of the expiration or other termination of the Project.”
返还范围只明示受保护信息本身。
返还范围明示信息及副本。
返还范围明示信息、副本及衍生材料。
返还动作只针对副本或复制件。
返还全部来源所述相关材料，边界由逐字证据限定。
返还有其他明确材料范围。
只判断返还动作明示覆盖的材料，不把销毁材料范围复制给返还。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and”
销毁范围只明示受保护信息本身。
销毁范围明示信息及副本。
销毁范围明示信息、副本及衍生材料。
销毁动作只针对副本或复制件。
销毁全部来源所述相关材料，边界由逐字证据限定。
销毁有其他明确材料范围。

只判断销毁或永久擦除动作明示覆盖的材料，不把返还材料范围复制给销毁。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them.”
窗口明示允许保留限定材料。
窗口明示禁止保留限定材料。
窗口对不同材料或条件同时明示留存许可和禁止。
完整供应窗口没有明示留存许可或禁止；处置义务本身不改变此选择。

判断窗口是否明示处置后的留存许可或留存禁止。不得仅因要求全量返还或销毁就选择 explicit_retention_prohibition。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.”
许可限于常规备份或档案存储。
许可限于法律或监管要求的记录副本。
许可限于争议解决用途的单一或限定副本。
许可限于内部合规用途。
窗口明示多个不同留存依据。
窗口明示其他留存依据。
窗口没有明示留存许可依据。

若窗口明示留存许可，分类其依据；不得把备份例外扩展成所有材料的留存许可。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law. ” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“2) a single copy of all Confidential Information may be retained by the Receiving Party’s legal department for dispute resolution purposes only, provided, however, that such Confidential Information shall remain subject to the terms and conditions of this Confidentiality Agreement.”
留存效力明示适用于信息本身。
留存效力明示适用于信息及副本。
留存效力明示适用于信息、副本和衍生材料。
留存效力只适用于副本或记录副本。
留存效力适用于来源明示的全部相关材料。
留存效力具有其他明确材料范围。
窗口没有明示留存效力或没有给出其材料范围。

判断明示留存许可或禁止适用的精确材料范围，不把备份、记录副本、普通副本和全部信息相互替代。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law. ”

Facility Tour Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement
This FACILITY TOUR CONFIDENTIALITY AND NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of this date: ____________ between Hydranautics, a California corporation (“Hydranautics”) and __________________ (“Visitor”).
During the facility tour(s), Visitor will observe Hydranautics’ business operations and facilities which may give Visitor access to some of Hydranautics’ Confidential Information as defined below.
Accordingly, as a condition of and in consideration of touring Hydranautics’ facilities, Visitor agrees that:
1. The term “Confidential Information” shall include all Hydranautics’ trade secrets and information that concerns the confidential business or affairs of Hydranautics and Nitto including without limitation, financial information and reports, business plans, design and construction plans, manufacturing processes, customer lists, employee data, forecasts, strategies, and all other proprietary business information.
2. Visitor agrees and acknowledges that in the course of, or incident to, the tour of Hydranautics’ facilities, Hydranutics may provide to, or Visitor will otherwise become exposed to Hydranautics’ Confidential Information.
3. Visitor agrees to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and will exercise at least the same care with respect thereto as it exercises with respect to its’ own confidential or proprietary information and will not without Hydranautics’ consent use, divulge, copy, release, sell, loan or otherwise reveal such Confidential Information to others.
4. Visitor agrees he/she will not remove any document, equipment or other materials from the premises without Hydranautics’ written consent. Visitor will not photograph, videotape, or otherwise make any record of or preserve any Confidential Information to which he/she may be given access during the facility tour(s).
5. Visitor will abide by all safety regulations, stay within designated areas of the facility per the established tour, and will not leave the touring party without an escort by a Hydranautics authorized employee.
6. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
7. This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter.
8. Visitor understands that his or her breach of this Agreement may subject him or her and his or her employees to liability.
